title: Vehicle sizes
hints: A spot now has two facts (its size and who is in it), and a stay needs the vehicle type to be priced. Promote both to small records.

Map names to ranks so 'big enough' is a number comparison: `SIZE_RANK = {"small": 0, "medium": 1, "large": 2}` and `MIN_RANK = {"motorcycle": 0, "car": 1, "truck": 2}`. A vehicle fits when `SIZE_RANK[spot.size] >= MIN_RANK[vehicle]`.
For `park_auto`, the best spot is the minimum of the free fitting spots under the key `(SIZE_RANK[spot.size], spot_id)`. Tuple keys give you 'smallest size, then lowest id' in one `min`.

Keep `park_auto` honest by delegating: find the spot id, then call your own `park` so the validation and bookkeeping live in one place. Store `vehicle` on the stay and look the rate up from it in your fee helper.
